def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read()
    lines = data.split()
    if not lines:
        print(-1); return
    w = max(len(l) for l in lines)
    W = w + 1
    g = bytearray(b'#' * W)
    for l in lines:
        g += l.ljust(w, b'#') + b'#'
    g += b'#' * W
    s = g.find(b'S'); e = g.find(b'E')
    if s < 0 or e < 0:
        print(-1); return
    g[e] = 46
    g[s] = 35
    frontier = [s]
    d = 0
    while frontier:
        d += 1
        nxt = []
        app = nxt.append
        for c in frontier:
            n = c + 1
            if g[n] == 46:
                g[n] = 35; app(n)
            n = c - 1
            if g[n] == 46:
                g[n] = 35; app(n)
            n = c + W
            if g[n] == 46:
                g[n] = 35; app(n)
            n = c - W
            if g[n] == 46:
                g[n] = 35; app(n)
        if g[e] == 35:
            print(d); return
        frontier = nxt
    print(-1)
main()
